scope: Every finished cc-matrix run not already on the wall: the 2026-10-29 GPT-6 matrix (3 models x 3 efforts x 10 sources) and the earlier Star Fox 64 / Mario Kart 64 runs (2026-10-20 to 2026-10-27).
filenamePolicy: The run's own GameTitle-SOURCE-model-effort-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.html, with spaces as hyphens and a literal SOURCE replaced by the source id. Imported with scripts/ingest.mjs (provenance sourceKind cc-matrix-run).
capturePolicy: Real GPU (RTX 3060 Ti, headless Windows Chrome over CDP) at 960x720, encoded 640x480 JPEG quality 58: title, then two play views. Every strip was inspected; games stuck in menus were reshot with gentler input or from their own attract demo.
notes: BumbleBlock Cabaret throws on Play (RAPIER.RigidBodyDesc...setEnabledTranslations is not a function), so it has a title cover only; imported unmodified.
Clockwork Cower, Far Cryin' Out Loud and Star Party Crashers declare their session as hub:mode/hub:players; their overrides carry sessionMode parallel and sessionPlayers 1-4.
